name: Focus Mode
description: Clears visual distractions: hides desktop icons, auto-hides the taskbar and minimizes other windows for a timed session.
author: AETHER

settings.label: Session length
settings.description: 0 keeps Focus Mode on until you turn it off.

documentation.whatItChanges: Desktop icon view state, taskbar auto-hide (SHAppBarMessage) and window minimization.
documentation.uninstall: Everything is restored when the session ends or the mod is disabled.
documentation.limitations: Windows does not offer a public API to turn on Do Not Disturb, so notifications are not silenced.
